thread:
maria (PM): Heads-up 00Telco wants pilot but requires team-level access and an auditable export. They said it's a blocker unless we give a mitigation plan.

lee (ENG): Full RBAC + admin console is multi-sprint. We can do a \"pilot-access\" mode: IdP group->team mapping, admin/member roles, signed event export. Feature-flagged per tenant. ~1 week.

zoe (UX): We'll add a clear "Pilot access" banner in onboarding and a small mapping modal. Minimal disruption.

dave (SRE): For audit, append-only logs with HMAC signing + S3 export should be fine for pilot. Retention config comes in v1.

sam (AE): Telco will agree to pilot if we commit to full RBAC within 60 days and provide acceptance tests (Okta + AD).

maria (PM): Option A: delay public MVP to include full RBAC. Option B: ship MVP on time and provide a feature-flagged pilot path + 60-day v1 commitment. Vote?

lee (ENG): +1 for B. Keeps the public schedule stable. We'll gate on Dedicated staging and use a per-tenant flag to limit blast radius.

zoe (UX): +1 for B. I'll prepare banner copy calling this \"Pilot access controls\" and link to the v1 roadmap.

dave (SRE): +1 if we add a rollback toggle and export health checks. I'll own that.

maria (PM): consensus = B. Action items:
 - maria: draft pilot amendment + acceptance criteria (today)
 - lee: implement pilot-access adapter + feature flag; PR in 5 working days
 - dave: HMAC signing + S3 export + runbook in 4 working days
 - zoe: mapping modal + banner in 3 working days
 - sam: get verbal OK and circulate contract (EOD)

legal-bot: attached clause template for 60-day delivery window.

sam (AE): Telco gave verbal OK; legal wants the 60-day window in writing. I'll push.

lee (ENG): I'll feature-flag the rollout and add Okta/AD test vectors. Logging spike tickets now.

zoe (UX): mock uploaded to product doc. banner reads: \"Pilot access controls enabled for select customers. See limitations.\"

dave (SRE): export pipeline tested to s3://telco-pilot-logs (retention 30d). Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria for pilot sign:
1) IdP group mapping configurable via modal or CLI;
2) Role-lite enforcement (admin/member);
3) Signed append-only event log exported to S3;
4) Per-tenant feature flag + rollback toggle;
5) Demo with Okta/AD.

sam (AE): Contract signed. Onboarding scheduled Day 6.

lee (ENG): PR opened (draft) for pilot-access. Will canary on Dedicated tenant.

maria (PM): closing: MVP ships on time publicly; Telco pilot runs on feature-flagged pilot-access with v1 commitment in 60 days. Keep updates here.

zoe (UX): adding final copy to onboarding flows.

dave (SRE): runbook added for export verification and rollback.

maria (PM): thanks team. If Day 7 risk shows up call it out here immediately.
